label: Если
description: Conditional sentences that teach how Russian builds real-world 'if / then' logic.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Basic conditional. 1. 'Если' introduces the condition. 2. 'Придешь' is future and matches 'ты'. 3. 'Мы начнем' gives the result, showing the full if-then structure.
Strategic focus: Weather condition. 1. 'Будет дождь' sets a realistic trigger. 2. 'Останемся' is the future/reflexive response. 3. 'Дома' keeps the outcome practical and natural.

missions.phrase: если у тебя есть время, позвони мне
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Polite condition plus request. 1. 'Если у тебя есть время' is a very common everyday condition. 2. 'Позвони' is the imperative form. 3. 'Мне' is the dative target of the call.
Strategic focus: Soft offer. 1. 'Если хочешь' makes the offer feel natural instead of forceful. 2. 'Я помогу' is a clear future-help response. 3. This is a high-value conversational pattern.

missions.phrase: если он не отвечает, я жду
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Negated condition. 1. 'Не отвечает' shows a common real-life situation. 2. 'Я жду' is a simple present response. 3. The sentence is useful because it combines timing with uncertainty.
Strategic focus: Impersonal condition. 1. 'Если нужно' is a short, flexible trigger phrase. 2. 'Мы вернемся' is future and plural. 3. 'Позже' adds a very common time adverb.

missions.phrase: если цена высокая, я не покупаю
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Decision logic. 1. 'Цена высокая' creates a clear evaluation. 2. 'Я не покупаю' shows the resulting choice. 3. This sentence teaches practical logic, not just grammar.

missions.phrase: если книга интересная, я читаю её быстро
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Condition plus object pronoun. 1. 'Книга интересная' sets the condition. 2. 'Я читаю ее' keeps the object visible and concrete. 3. 'Быстро' gives a simple but useful speed modifier.

missions.phrase: если они опоздают, встреча начнется без них
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Future result. 1. 'Опоздают' and 'начнется' are both future, so the sentence feels real. 2. 'Без них' reinforces the object form after a preposition. 3. This is a strong everyday planning sentence.

missions.phrase: если хочешь чай, я налью чай
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Repeated noun for reinforcement. 1. The repeated 'чай' keeps the line easy to type and remember. 2. 'Налью' is a practical action verb. 3. This is a compact, useful household sentence.
